'''Fuel injectors''' were [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] components used for controlling a vehicle's acceleration. The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|parts dealer]] was known to sell several kinda of fuel injectors, most notably from the [[44 PCX Injector|PCX]] [[Dual 20 PCX Injector|series]] [[Dual 32 PCX Injector|of]] [[Quad 32 PCX Injector|fuel injectors]] and the [[Quad 44 Injector]]. One of the most expensive fuel injectors was the [[Mag-6 Injector]], which cost 14000 truguts.
